_comment: Additions patch for PerryLink/dsh-catalog data/packages.json (schema: { npm, repo, displayName, categories, summary }). 'merge' = npm-backed entries, safe to append to data/packages.json together with the rows in 'snapshotAdditions' (append those to data/npm-snapshot.json in the same commit — check-data.mjs requires a snapshot row per listed npm name). 'deferred' = family repos with NO npm package; the current pipeline (check-data.mjs + build-catalog.mjs) requires an npm name and a snapshot row, so these are annotated per the existing schema with npm:null and must NOT be merged into data/packages.json until either (a) they are published to npm, or (b) the pipeline gains non-npm entry support. displayNameZh/summaryZh are schema-extension fields (tolerated by both scripts, ignored by build-catalog.mjs today; exporters can read them). dsh-wechat is excluded per user instruction. Canonical 43 = 36 runtime + 7 tooling; minus dsh-wechat = 42 npm-backed canonical entries; current packages.json holds 40 rows of which 38 are canonical (2 are deprecated legacy names dsh-plugin-upgrade / dsh-plugin-upgrade-rc1, superseded by dsh-plugin-upgrade-015). The 4 'merge' entries are exactly the canonical gap.
